acceptance: `todo-db --version` and `todo-db-mcp --version` print the installed package version and exit 0 without resolving a state remote or config.
description: `todo-db --version` prints the usage and "the following arguments are required: command" (0.11.0); `src/todo_db/cli.py` defines no version option. Checking a rollout today needs `uv tool list`, which only covers uv tool installs, or an MCP `initialize` handshake to read `serverInfo.version`. The "After the tag" steps in `docs/operations/release-gates.md` ask the operator to confirm the new version.
